key.name: snap
key.description: In the classic layout, dragging a window to the top of the screen, or Super+Z, shows six layouts to drop it on.

key.name: snap-chooser
key.summary: Show the snap layouts for the focused window
key.description: Opens the snap layouts for the window in use, in the classic layout.

key.name: switcher
key.summary: Window switcher you can type into
key.description: In the classic layout, Super+Tab and Alt+Tab show every window in a grid; typing keeps the ones whose app or title matches.

key.name: hold-super
key.description: Holding Super alone shows the main shortcuts and the dock's numbers.

key.name: hold-super-delay
key.description: In milliseconds, before the shortcuts show.

key.name: corner-top-left
key.description: What pushing the pointer into this corner of the screen does: nothing, the overview, show the desktop, lock the screen, a quick note, or the notifications.

key.name: corner-top-right
key.description: What pushing the pointer into this corner of the screen does: nothing, the overview, show the desktop, lock the screen, a quick note, or the notifications.

key.name: corner-bottom-left
key.description: What pushing the pointer into this corner of the screen does: nothing, the overview, show the desktop, lock the screen, a quick note, or the notifications.

key.name: corner-bottom-right
key.description: What pushing the pointer into this corner of the screen does: nothing, the overview, show the desktop, lock the screen, a quick note, or the notifications.

key.name: show-desktop
key.summary: Click the wallpaper to show the desktop
key.description: In the classic layout, windows slide to the edges of the screen; a click brings them back.

key.name: gesture-pinch
key.summary: Pinch with three fingers for the app grid
key.description: A three-finger pinch on the touchpad opens the app grid.

key.name: gesture-spread
key.summary: Spread three fingers to show the desktop
key.description: Three fingers spread on the touchpad show the desktop, in the classic layout.

key.name: gesture-down
key.summary: Three fingers down for the app's windows
key.description: Three fingers down on the touchpad fan the windows of the app in use out from the dock.

key.name: gesture-today
key.description: Four fingers to the left on the touchpad open Today and the notifications; to the right close them.

key.name: places
key.description: In the classic layout, for each arrangement of screens, apps' windows open where they were.

key.name: dim
key.summary: Dim the windows not in use
key.description: The windows behind the one in use are drawn a little darker.

key.name: drop-down
key.description: Super+Alt+Return slides a terminal down from the top of the screen and hides it again, still running.

key.name: drop-down-key
key.summary: Show or hide the drop-down terminal and the scratchpad
key.description: Shows the drop-down terminal, with the scratchpad's windows in the classic layout, and hides them again.

key.name: scratchpad
key.description: In the classic layout, any window can go to the scratchpad from its menu: out of sight, shown and hidden with the drop-down terminal.

key.name: keep-on-top
key.description: Super+Alt+P keeps the window in use above the rest; a window kept on top has a ring in the accent and a pin.

key.name: keep-on-top-key
key.summary: Keep the window in use on top, or let it go

key.name: see-through
key.description: Super+Alt and the scroll wheel over a window set its opacity, from 40 % to fully solid, until it closes.

key.name: see-through-apps
key.summary: Apps whose windows are always see-through
key.description: Each launcher ID (such as kitty.desktop) with the opacity its windows open at, from 40 to 100 percent.

key.name: frame
key.summary: A frame in the theme's colours
key.description: In the classic layout, a still gradient line from the theme's colours round the window in use.

key.name: recording-sizes
key.description: The window menu's Size for recording makes a window 1280 × 720, 1920 × 1080, square or upright, centred.

key.name: reopen
key.description: Super+Alt+T opens again the app whose window closed last, on its workspace and at its place; five back. Kept in memory only.

key.name: simple-desktop
key.description: Big tiles on the wallpaper, large text, a larger pointer, one window at a time and a plain top bar with Home, for this account. Off puts back what each setting held.

key.name: simple-tiles
key.description: Launcher IDs (name.desktop), six at most. Empty: the internet, email, photos and files, by the apps this account opens them with.

key.name: hand-over
key.description: A window's menu offers Hand this over: that window alone, full screen, until the screen is locked. A courtesy, not a security boundary.
